reason: Reject the selected-component-root prototype: none of the four intended first-use TPSA/ASA lanes demonstrates an improvement. NCI TPSA 1.006x [0.992,1.012] (12/20 faster), ASA 0.997x [0.978,1.008] (9/20); ChEMBL TPSA 0.995x [0.981,0.999] (6/20), ASA 0.999x [0.989,1.005] (9/20). All 42 initial source-relative lanes lack a strict win. The predeclared separate follow-up reproduces slower ChEMBL first-use TPSA: 0.991x [0.986,0.998], 5/20 faster; NCI parse-inclusive MACCS also remains below baseline: 0.997x [0.993,0.999], 4/20. No pooling, substitutions or recursive retries were used. MACCS timing movement in an unchanged path is not evidence of a new algorithm; binary layout and host noise may contribute. Exact ring sequences/order match in 168864 differential comparisons; all 14072-input descriptor and Morgan outputs, 1221 native tests and 1389 Python tests pass. Correctness does not justify a speed optimization without benefit. Existing twelve accepted source candidates remain unchanged. Complete superiority is still not established: NCI first-use ASA reference/candidate ratios are RDKit 0.211x and COSMolKit 0.088x; preparation differs, and COSMolKit ring-count mismatches remain unranked.
